verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official, well-documented CLI. Docs cover installation on Linux, macOS and Windows, login and token configuration, releases, debug files, source maps, code mappings, crons, sending events, log streaming and snapshots. The docs also describe an interactive developer CLI offering issue management, AI-powered analysis and API access "for humans and agents," and pair it with the MCP server for use inside agent conversations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in agent workflows, and deeper documentation of the agent-oriented CLI's specific features.
